David Phillips, DDS
MORE+
David Phillips, DDS
Dr. David Phillips was born in Charlotte, North Carolina and a distinguished dentist admired his skill, compassion, and versatility across diverse practice settings. A UNC School of Dentistry graduate, he has served in private practice, FQHCs, and mobile care for nursing facilities. Passionate about oral surgery and restorative treatments, he builds lasting patient trust with warmth and dedication. Outside dentistry, he treasures family, golfing, kayaking, reading, and cherishing life as a proud grandfather.

Do you offer pediatric dental care in Kannapolis?

Our Kannapolis office does offer pediatric dental care. The whole family can visit and make sure everyone keeps right on smiling.

What cosmetic dental treatments are offered in Kannapolis?

We offer tooth whitening and other cosmetic dental procedures at our Kannapolis location.

How can I find an emergency dentist in Kannapolis, NC?

Give us a call at (704) 938-4211 if you have a dental emergency. We do our best to fit emergency appointments in on the same or next business day. If we cannot see you at our Kannapolis location based on dentist availability or practice hours, we can often see you at one of our nearby locations.

What should I expect during my first dental visit in Kannapolis?

We’ll perform a comprehensive dental evaluation during your first visit and perform a comprehensive cleaning. We may take x-rays, and will screen for cavities, gum disease, and oral cancer.
